# KaspaCom Wallet

KaspaCom Wallet is a self-custody browser wallet for KAS and supported Kaspa assets at wallet.kaspa.com.

## Primary pages

- [KaspaCom Wallet](https://wallet.kaspa.com/): Explains what KaspaCom Wallet is, who it is for, and how users open the wallet.
- [Wallet features](https://wallet.kaspa.com/features): Lists the supported wallet jobs: create or import, receive KAS, send KAS, view supported assets, use supported swap flows, and connect to KaspaCom products.
- [Wallet security](https://wallet.kaspa.com/security): Explains self-custody, seed phrase backup, browser storage, phishing checks, and the wallet.kaspa.com domain.
- [Wallet FAQ](https://wallet.kaspa.com/faq): Short answers for common Kaspa wallet, web wallet, app, download, address, login, and storage questions.

## Guides

- [Best Kaspa wallet](https://wallet.kaspa.com/guides/best-kaspa-wallet): Explains when a browser wallet fits and when colder storage may fit larger long-term balances.
- [Kaspa wallet app](https://wallet.kaspa.com/guides/kaspa-wallet-app): Explains that KaspaCom Wallet runs in a mobile-friendly browser instead of a native iOS or Android app in this phase.
- [Kaspa desktop wallet](https://wallet.kaspa.com/guides/kaspa-desktop-wallet): Explains that KaspaCom Wallet does not require a desktop download.
- [Create a Kaspa wallet](https://wallet.kaspa.com/guides/create-kaspa-wallet): Explains the create-wallet flow and seed phrase backup requirement.
- [How to store Kaspa](https://wallet.kaspa.com/guides/store-kaspa): Explains active hot-wallet storage, offline seed phrase backup, and device hygiene.
